mentions.name: Kubernetes From the Problems Up
mentions.description: This is a course for understanding Kubernetes at a high level — its details and motivations rather than deep technical depth. Each chapter is framed as an evolution of a startup encountering a problem, showing how Kubernetes solves that problem while treating the reader as the technical manager in the situation. It was created while learning Kubernetes with the help of Claude Opus, with the author steering the output as they learn.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been learning kubernetes with the help of Claude Opus and trying to build it into a course which others might find useful: https://gravitypersists.github.io/kubernetes-from-the-problems-up/
